snippet.title: Gunmetal Gothic - May 2025 Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Gameplay footage from Gunmetal Gothic, a co-op retro-3D shooter-RPG in development by ynoham.  Solo playthrough of the tutorial mission, followed by multiplayer gameplay clips, showing the CRT effect and high resolution options.  Coming to Steam Early Access in 2026, demo coming soon!

0:00 Tutorial mission
2:03 CRT effect
4:48 Multiplayer
5:29 High resolution

Steam Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248150/Gunmetal_Gothic/
